title: Wire recipe detail bottom bar to sheet flow
description: Pass recipe and current scale into the bottom bar, replace the shopping-list stub alert with sheet presentation, and show post-success confirmation feedback from recipe detail.
acceptance_criteria: The Add to shopping list action is disabled while the recipe is loading or has no ingredients, with the specified accessibility hint for empty recipes.
`RecipeDetailSheet` passes parsed recipe and current scale through, presents the add sheet, and shows a visible success confirmation after commits.

handoff_summary.completed: RecipeBottomBar updated with recipe/scale/onAddToShoppingList API and disabled-state logic. RecipeDetailSheet updated with environment dependencies, sheet presentation, and success toast. Build succeeded (BUILD SUCCEEDED, no errors).
handoff_summary.risks: The #Preview for RecipeDetailSheet no longer injects the required environment objects (RecipesFolderStore, AisleCatalog), so the canvas preview will crash at runtime in Xcode. This is a developer-ergonomics issue, not a production risk — the preview was already non-functional (pointing at /tmp). A tester or review agent may flag this.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify the button disabled states (loading, no-ingredient recipe, normal recipe) and that the sheet presents and dismisses correctly with the toast appearing on success.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No file-scope conflicts expected. AddToShoppingListSheet, RecipesFolderStore, AisleCatalog, and RecipesListView were read-only; only the two assigned files were modified.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Deduplicated the Divider + RecipeBottomBar by moving them outside the if/else in RecipeDetailSheet — passes parsedRecipe (nil while loading) rather than repeating the block in both branches. Success toast uses a ZStack overlay with .regularMaterial capsule floating 88pt above the bottom edge, auto-dismissing after 2.5 s via Task.sleep.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Unit-testable logic: RecipeBottomBar.hasIngredients (nil recipe → false, empty ingredients → false, non-empty → true). UI flow: sheet presentation on button tap, onSuccess callback triggering successMessage state, Task.sleep auto-clear.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The Xcode Preview for RecipeDetailSheet will crash without injected environment objects. The RecipeBottomBar scale parameter is accepted but not yet rendered in the button label — left as-is per spec scope.

conflict_risks: No file-scope conflicts expected. AddToShoppingListSheet, RecipesFolderStore, AisleCatalog, and RecipesListView were read-only; only the two assigned files were modified.

execution_history.summary: Wired recipe detail bottom bar to the add-to-shopping-list sheet flow. RecipeBottomBar now accepts recipe and scale, disables the shopping-list button while loading or when there are no ingredients, and fires a callback instead of showing a stub alert. RecipeDetailSheet presents AddToShoppingListSheet on demand and shows an animated capsule success toast for 2.5 s after a successful commit.
